categories.purpose: Capture Inbox: screenshots and screen recordings land here; emptied on every tidy run.
Personal life records: health, family, events, household.
Employer and job material: company documents, processes, troubleshooting, meeting recordings, test results.
Anything about money: invoices, receipts, bills, reimbursements, ledgers.
Creative work and reusable assets: videos, images, subtitles, fonts.
Installers and packages that are kept on purpose.
Material the owner explicitly retired but wants to keep, grouped by year of archiving.
Sensitive Zone: identity documents, passwords, tokens, keys, credentials.
